spouse.prompt.title: What do you want to say to {{npc}}?
spouse.reply.failed: Sorry, I lost my train of thought.
input.hint: Press Enter to send, or Escape to cancel.
cyberju.intro: I am CyberJu, the AI assistant of a Stardew Valley farm. My job is to help the farmer understand the current game state and decide what matters most. What would you like to talk about?
cyberju.unreachable: Sorry, I couldn't reach the Agent.
config.enable-spouse.name: Enable Spouse Conversation
config.enable-spouse.tooltip: Whether your spouse answers through the AI agent instead of vanilla dialogue.
config.type-to-spouse.name: Type To Spouse
config.type-to-spouse.tooltip: Hold this key and click your spouse to write your own message.
config.offer-typed.name: Offer "Something Else"
config.offer-typed.tooltip: Add a *Something else* option so you can type a reply instead of picking a suggestion.
config.agent-endpoint.name: Agent URL
config.agent-endpoint.tooltip: Full URL of the agent that writes your spouse's replies, including port. Default: http://127.0.0.1:8000/chat
config.agent-timeout.name: Agent Timeout (seconds)
config.agent-timeout.tooltip: Give up on a reply after this long and show a fallback line.
config.api-note: Changing the address or port rebinds the API as soon as this menu closes. If the new port is already in use the existing listener is kept.
config.bind-address.name: Bind Address
config.bind-address.tooltip: Address the read-only calendar API listens on. Keep it on 127.0.0.1 unless you know what you're doing.
config.port.name: Port
config.port.tooltip: Port the read-only calendar API listens on.
